packet_dag.terminal_condition: All safe launchable work is committed, pushed, deployed, and live-smoked; all unsafe or external-owner work is explicitly blocked without staging unrelated dirty files.

title: Clean Launch Everything Safely

reasons: The operator requested clean, push, deploy, and launch everything across the current workspace.
The current worktree contains tracked dirty code plus a large number of untracked generated artifacts.
The active execution run has remaining blockers that cannot be solved by blindly staging files.
affected_product_surfaces: agent fleet and ChatGPT drop-off artifact queues
likely_external_provider_blockers: One Time provider aliases for Zoom/Vimeo/Stripe/Whapi remain account-owner gated.
join.onetimeonetime.com separate Railway target is not configured in this local Railway context.
Drive/private transcript sync, external sends, payments, DNS writes, access grants, and provider account mutations require exact approved packets.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Inventory the dirty worktree and separate safe launchable work from unrelated generated artifacts and external-owner blockers.

operator_intent_summary: Clean the workspace, push all safe launchable work, deploy it, and make the app launch-ready without sweeping unsafe, unrelated, private, credentialed, or unverified artifacts into Git.

decisions_captured.decision: Do not interpret 'push everything' as permission to commit secrets, raw private data, unrelated dirty work, or unverified generated artifacts.
Safe launchable batches may be committed and deployed without asking for ordering confirmation.

out_of_scope: Blind git add of the full dirty worktree.
Deleting or reverting user/agent dirty work solely to make git status clean.
Payment, DNS, external email/WhatsApp/Telegram sends, credential mutations, provider account writes, access grants, Drive/Vimeo uploads, or Stripe live charges without an exact approved packet.
Committing raw private message bodies, contact exports, student/parent private records, secrets, passwords, or private screenshots.
Declaring blocked historical execution-run requirements done without the required external account or runtime proof.

inspection_targets: git status short tracked and untracked output
git diff for tracked dirty files
active execution run requirements and blockers
test and watchdog commands relevant to safe batches
known_blockers: Active execution run still has blocked requirements for agent fleet drift, Drive parser/private transcript workflow, provider aliases, and one-time Railway bootstrap context.
Worktree contains many generated untracked pickup/audit artifacts that need classification before staging.
Separate join.onetimeonetime.com release-captain target is not configured in the current local Railway context.

expanded_phrases.clean: Produce a classified release-ready worktree: safe scoped work committed and pushed, generated clutter summarized or parked, and blockers recorded without destructive deletion.
expanded_phrases.clean up everything: Classify dirty files, commit safe work, leave unrelated work untouched, and record exact blockers.
expanded_phrases.launch everything: Deploy only verified app-visible work and live-smoke the affected routes.
expanded_phrases.push everything: Push all safe scoped commits, not secrets/private data/unverified generated junk.
expanded_phrases.deploy everything: Use the approved Railway release path and confirm terminal deployment success.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Release cleanup is an audit-first operation: inventory, validate, stage narrowly, commit, push, deploy, smoke, then ledger/changelog closeout.

requirements.statement: Capture and validate the release-cleanup request before staging broad work.
requirements.expected_result: Raw intake, register, and PQC packet exist and pass validation.
